question: Hey, Oda-sensei!! This is kinda random, but I was just wondering what Wanze's thing (→) was used for? by Nappe
answer: Those are "Pop Up Goggles"! Special ordered! He is the head cook, so of course, he uses them while cooking. It's for when he cuts the onions!! He absolutely treasures those goggles because they keep him from crying. Also, he does not use them for anything other than slicing onions!!
name: Nappe
